contract: Single-mode source judge composition and rating regex run in ScriptSpec. Four profiles (default/math, first/multi-turn) preserve source prompts, OpenAI chat-completions and legacy Anthropic completions request bodies, fractional 1-to-10 ratings, per-turn means and overall mean. Normalized reward is (rating-1)/9.

source_modes.single: Implemented and fixture-tested for all four profiles on both providers.
source_modes.pairwise-baseline: Actual source two-model judgments write model_1/model_2 and winner fields; source evaluator expects model/score and raises KeyError. Excluded.
source_modes.pairwise-all: Source evaluate_responses hardcodes models=[results[model_id]] even with two answer files loaded. It constructs zero pairs and fails reading an absent judgment artifact. The observed ValueError proves this singleton/no-match path, not pairwise column equivalence. Excluded.

corrections: Missing/out-of-range ratings and malformed/incomplete transport abort the entire batch; no source filtering of failed samples. SDK retries remain; source outer 16 retries are bypassed.
Each question needs both turn matches; incomplete populations cannot change aggregate weights.
Empty candidate turn receives source minimum 1 / verifyit reward 0 despite positive judge output.
Clear stale judgment artifact before validation/scoring and write only a complete successful current batch.
limitations: Fixture-only evaluator evidence with local HTTP responses; no live judge or archived model replay. No matching tracker/local named traces.
Timestamps remain in source-shaped output and raw verdict evidence; deterministic parity excludes only tstamp.
The original legacy Anthropic completions protocol is retained, not upgraded to Messages.
Append the bundled MTBench directory to import lookup for its source fastchat package; original dependencies required.
Each judge Script has a 900-second deadline; candidate execution is not involved.
